title: Kortix manifest (kortix_version 2)
description: kortix.yaml, schema version 2 — YAML-only. `agents` is a name→block MAP, GOVERNANCE ONLY (connectors/secrets/skills/kortix_permissions/workspace/enabled) plus `file`, the path of the agent’s `.md`; every agent must be declared, and agent behavior (description/model/mode/temperature/permission/the prompt itself) lives entirely in that agent’s own `.md` frontmatter + body (`agents.<name>.file`, default `agents/<name>.md`) — authoring any of those fields here is a hard error. `[[channels]]` is removed outright.

runtime.description: Selects nothing: every new session runs pi.

codemode.description: pi's codemode tool: the model writes a script that calls the other tools. on (default) keeps the other tools declared, only gives the model codemode alone, off removes it. An agent's value replaces the top-level one.

tools.description: Tools: tool name → repo-relative path of the module that implements it, or `kortix:<name>` for a Kortix tool. Each module default-exports { description, parameters (JSON Schema), execute(args, context) }. Every harness loads them. With a `tools` key, sessions get only the Kortix tools it lists; without one, they get all five.

anyOf.description: The Kortix web_search tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix image_search tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix scrape_webpage tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix memory tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix show tool, maintained by Kortix.

file.description: Repo-relative path of this agent's .md (frontmatter + prompt). Defaults to agents/<name>.md.

tools.description: Which tools this agent may use: harness tools (bash, read, edit, …), Kortix tools (web_search, memory, show, …) and project tools (top-level `tools`). `all` (default) or `none`; a list allows only those; `{ exclude: [...] }` allows every tool but those. A map of tool name → boolean is the earlier form.

network_egress.description: Non-enforcing declaration. Outbound network access remains unrestricted until provider gateway isolation ships.

connectors.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

connectors_required.description: Connector slugs that must resolve before the session starts.

policy_sets.description: Connector slug → the policy set (connectors[].policy_sets) this agent gets on it. Absent: the base rules.

secrets.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

skills.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

apps.description: Kortix Apps (by App slug) this agent may open when the App is restricted or private. Deny by default.

kortix_permissions.description: Kortix permissions: the project.* IAM actions this agent may exercise, or "all" / "none".

workspace.description: What new sessions of this agent get in /workspace.

project_repository.description: Check out the project repository and allow repository access. Defaults to true.

codemode.description: pi's codemode tool: the model writes a script that calls the other tools. on (default) keeps the other tools declared, only gives the model codemode alone, off removes it. An agent's value replaces the top-level one.

project.description: `name`: the project's name. A push that changes it renames the project, and a rename in Kortix commits it here. `description`: text for people who read the repository.

env.description: The secret names the project expects. Values live in Secrets, never in this file.

required.description: Secret names the project needs: uppercase letters, digits and `_`, not starting with a digit. The dashboard and `kortix ship` ask for a missing value. A missing value does not block a session.

optional.description: Secret names the same prompts offer. Values live in Secrets, never in this file.

config_dir.description: Directory with the OpenCode-only files (opencode.jsonc, plugins/, tools/). Defaults to harnesses/opencode, then the legacy .kortix/opencode.

sandbox.description: Sandbox templates and the project's default template. Default: the platform image.

slug.description: Unique. Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, at most 64 characters. `default` is reserved.

name.description: The label in the template picker. Default: the slug.

entrypoint.description: Overrides the container entrypoint. Default: the image's.

image.description: An image with a tag or a digest. No tag is an error. `:latest` is a warning. Set `image` or `dockerfile`, not both.

dockerfile.description: A repository path to a Dockerfile. `kortix validate` lints it: no `COPY` from the repository, no `RUN` heredoc, a Debian-family base image.

cpu.description: vCPU cores. Above 32 is a warning, and Kortix uses 32. Default: the platform default.

memory.description: GiB of memory. Above 128 is a warning, and Kortix uses 128. Default: the platform default.

disk.description: GiB of disk. Above 500 is a warning, and Kortix uses 500. Default: the platform default.

default.description: A slug from `sandbox.templates`, or `default` for the platform image.

triggers.description: Schedules, webhooks and App events that start agent work.

type.description: Required in the flat form: the trigger without `on` and `run`. `type` next to `on` is an error.

target.description: Flat form of `run.app`, `run.path`, `run.method` and `run.payload`: `{ app, path, method, payload }`.

slug.description: Unique. Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, at most 128 characters.

name.description: The label in the dashboard. Default: the slug.

filter.description: Payload path → a value (equals), or one operator: `not`, `in`, `exists`, `prefix`, `not_prefix`. A fire runs only when every path matches.

max_runs_per_hour.description: Runs the trigger starts in any 60 minutes.

max_runs_per_day.description: Runs the trigger starts in a UTC day.

max_lateness.description: Schedules only, `60s` or more. A missed fire later than this does not run.

overlap.description: `skip` holds a fire while the previous run is active. Only with `run.session: fresh`. Default: `skip` for a schedule, `allow` for others.

on.description: What fires the trigger: a schedule (`cron`, `every` or `at`), a webhook, or an App event.

cron.description: A 6-field cron expression, seconds first: `"0 0 9 * * 1"` is 09:00 every Monday. A trigger fires at most once every 60 seconds.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone for `cron` and `at`.

every.description: A fixed period: an integer and `s`, `m`, `h` or `d`, at least `60s`.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone for `cron` and `at`.

at.description: One fire at an ISO-8601 time, such as `2026-06-01T09:00:00Z`.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone for `cron` and `at`.

secret.description: The name of the secret that signs requests to the trigger's webhook.

webhook.description: Fire on a signed request to the trigger's webhook URL.

event.description: With `on.app`: the App event name, or `"*"` for every event.

app.description: The App's slug. The trigger fires on that App's events.

run.description: What a fire runs: an agent turn, or a call to an App.

prompt.description: The first message of the run. Required unless `run.app` is set.

session.description: `fresh`: a new session for each fire. `reuse`: the last session this trigger created, or a new one when none can continue. `pinned`: the session `run.session_id`. `keyed`: one session for each value of `run.session_key`.

session_key.description: With `keyed`: a template over the payload, such as `"{{ body.chat_id }}"`. A key that renders empty runs `fresh`.

session_id.description: The session to run in. Required with `pinned`.

app.description: The fire calls this App instead of an agent.

path.description: With `run.app`: the request path. Starts with `/`.

connectors.description: Apps and APIs agents can call.

slug.description: Unique. Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, at most 128 characters. `kortix_slack`, `kortix_teams`, `kortix_email` and `computer` are reserved for the built-in connectors.

provider.description: How Kortix reaches the app or API. Kortix writes the `channel` entry when you connect a channel.

app.description: `composio` and `pipedream`: the app. Required for them.

spec.description: `openapi` and `postman`: the spec URL or repository path. Without it the connector does not load.

authorization_strategy.description: `project`: the connector's accounts belong to the project. `user`: each person connects their own account.

sensitive.description: `true`: a call that no rule matches needs approval, reads included.

auth.description: How Kortix sends the credential. The credential lives in Kortix, never in this file.

name.description: The header, query or cookie name. Required for `custom` and `api_key`.

prefix.description: Text before the credential value, such as `Bearer`.

headers.description: Static request headers, at most 32. The values are plain text in Git.

match.description: A glob over the connector's tool names, such as `send_*`.

conditions.description: Every condition must hold. Each is `{ arg, match, negate }`: `arg` is a dot path into the call's arguments, `match` is a glob or a `/regex/`, and `negate: true` inverts it.

policies.description: The base rules: `{ match, action, conditions }`.

policy_sets.description: Set name → `{ description, policies }`: a rule set an agent can be given with `agents.<name>.policy_sets`. A set name is lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, at most 64 characters, and not `base`. At most 32 sets of 200 rules each. Not on `channel` connectors.

match.description: A glob over the connector's tool names, such as `send_*`.

conditions.description: Every condition must hold. Each is `{ arg, match, negate }`: `arg` is a dot path into the call's arguments, `match` is a glob or a `/regex/`, and `negate: true` inverts it.

additionalProperties.description: One App's deploy settings. Any other key is an error.

config_dir.description: Directory with the OpenCode-only files (opencode.jsonc, plugins/, tools/). Defaults to harnesses/opencode, then the legacy .kortix/opencode.

pi.description: Pi native config directory (defaults to harnesses/pi, then .kortix/pi).

agentMdFrontmatter.description: Behavior for one agent — lives in its .md frontmatter (agents.<name>.file, default agents/<name>.md), never in the manifest. Provided here as an authoring aid; not itself part of kortix.yaml.

description.description: What the agent does. An agent that may start it as a subagent reads it to choose.

mode.description: `primary`: people and triggers run it; no agent starts it. `subagent`: only another agent starts it; agent pickers hide it. `all`: both.

variant.description: The model's reasoning level: `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`, when the model offers it.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. A model that refuses a custom temperature ignores it. Default: the model's.

steps.description: Model requests in one run. The request that reaches the limit gets no tools, so the model answers. Default: no limit.

color.description: Accepted. Sessions do not use it.

hidden.description: `true`: agent pickers do not list the agent.

options.description: Accepted. Sessions do not use it.
